name: @allowance/swarm
description: The center book: a pod-shop allocator for a swarm of trading agents, built on the Allowance mandate tree. Correlation-aware capital allocation, a drawdown stop-out that closes the agent's mandate subtree (optional cut rung), cross-agent crowding detection, and per-agent attributable track records. Zero runtime dependencies beyond @allowance/core.

scripts.test: node --import tsx --test src/allocator.test.ts src/tigercub.test.ts src/book.test.ts src/close.test.ts src/counterparty.test.ts src/operator-sizing.test.ts src/example.test.ts src/reserve.test.ts src/incidents.test.ts
